ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy SHA e7a31d5 introduced routing ruleset v4.17.3 (config_id=rt-cfg-20240312-001) containing rule #4819, a wildcard match on the X-Forwarded-For header with unlimited recursion depth. When this config was applied at 14:00:04Z, the recursive rule evaluator in evaluator.go:312 entered infinite recursion on every inbound request, causing a goroutine stack overflow and immediate crash across all three edge router nodes simultaneously. Because all nodes loaded the same bad config atomically, the crash loop prevented any node from recovering, taking the frontend 100% offline.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately roll back the active routing config to the previous known-good version rt-cfg-20240311-004 v4.17.2 using the config-manager rollback command: config-manager rollback --config-id rt-cfg-20240311-004. 2. Confirm all edge-router nodes pass health checks before declaring recovery. 3. Add a pre-deployment validation step to the routing config pipeline that enforces a maximum recursion depth limit on wildcard header match rules and runs a stress test against the rule evaluator before promoting to production. 4. Implement staged rollout for routing config changes to canary one node before applying globally to prevent simultaneous crashes.
